answer: One defence is stake-weighted reputation: to join the economy an agent locks a deposit in basalt-hard collateral that is slashed on fraud. Every action it broadcasts carries that history, so honest work builds a trustworthy echo that peers can verify before trusting it. A newcomer must finance its whole voyage through low-trust quotas before earning full rights, so an attacker spinning up ten thousand fake identities must fund ten thousand full deposits - multiplying the cost per identity until sybil attacks stop being profitable.
